title: Stormreach Challenge: Goblin Dojo
summary: Prove your group against the dojo's successive schools and its final master.
overview: Prove your group against the dojo's successive schools and its final master.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Stay inside the dojo and use the scripted pauses to recover before each new school.

phases.label: Students
phases.description: Defeat the elemental, emotional and animal schools in order.

phases.label: Sensei
phases.description: Remain ready for the final master rather than leaving the dojo.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Six players in the dojo start the challenge.
Defeat five elemental disciples, four emotional disciples, three animal disciples, then Silk and Steel together.
After the apparent congratulations, the Sensei becomes the final opponent.
The dojo boundary leashes enemies back and an empty room can fail the current stage.

notes: Approval E372. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The controller intentionally enables a historical retry bug after early-wave failure; later reset behavior must be verified before documenting guaranteed retries.
